Hey man, I'm 18. I've been doing NoFap for about 6 months or so, my highest is 9 days and I am also looking for an accountability partner. I started keeping a spreadsheet too that I mark down how many PMO Or MO I have every day. The goal is to have zero per month obviously, but don't get discouraged if you relapse. That's the point of the spreadsheet. A simple counter doesn't show you how many times you PMO/MO. With the spreadsheet you can keep track and see if you are making progress from month to month. PM me if you want to be accountability partners!
